extension.name: pi-proof
extension.installation: Pinned local checkout; explicitly loaded only in benchmark sessions. Normal Pi settings unchanged.

protocol.workflow: One fresh Pi RPC session per attempt; proof_start/test-first/implementation/proof_done; no external role chain
protocol.thinking: off, verified provider mapping none; same corrected provider files as clean enforced cohort
protocol.newAssistance: Test-runner package.json only, bounded TAP runner and partial environment helper. No product source, expected outcomes or behavioral tests supplied. Common workflow instructions are additional assistance.
protocol.helpers: All ten scored attempts use runtime-v2.cjs, with checkbox boolean and pointerdown/mousedown/pointerup/mouseup/click activation. Underlying seeded partial DOM/Canvas unchanged. Browser layout/default actions/GPU/PNG/path rendering unverified.
protocol.comparisonLimit: Workflow and helper access differ from older cohorts. Descriptive single trials, not a pure extension-only causal ablation.
protocol.order: Ornith five increasing-complexity prompts, then Qwen five, sequential on the single inference slot.

calibration.reason: Primary click helper v1 omitted pointerdown/pointerup, so a pointer-driven app was not activated by tests. Supervisor stopped attempt, retained artifact/transcript/costs and excluded it from means. A fresh timer repeat and all other scored attempts use v2.
